scope: Protected notifications that fail OSCORE processing are discarded without cancelling the observation; replayed and duplicate notifications deliver no second value

standard.name: IETF OSCORE
standard.text: An error condition occurring while processing a response to an observation request does not cancel the observation.

source_identity.kind: exact source-file SHA-256; no source commit association asserted

defect.observed: An unprotected 2.05 carrying the observation token followed by the genuine notification with one authentication-tag bit flipped ended an established observation with observation_failed
defect.cause: The worker mapped COAP_EVENT_OSCORE_DECRYPTION_FAILURE, NO_PROTECTED_PAYLOAD and DECODE_ERROR to a fatal exchange failure even when the failed message was a notification

assertions: While an observation is established and no request is pending, those three events discard the notification and the observation continues; the next change is delivered with no terminal error
The same events still end a pending request, registration, renewal or cancellation with security_handshake_failed
libcoap acknowledges the refused confirmable notification at the message layer, so its value is lost as if the datagram were dropped
A captured authenticated notification delivered three more times produces no second value, and the following change is delivered
The tampered/unprotected relay case fails against the preceding helper with observation_failed
